title: Video Watermark - Create & Add
summary: Create your own brand identity(Logo) and watermark your videos.
description:
Protect your Videos by adding watermark. Create your own brand identity(Logo) and watermark your videos.

You don't need a Computer to add watermark on videos. Video Watermark allows you to add watermark on videos right on your phone. 

Video Watermark works in background and let you do other things while adding watermark on videos in background.

Create your own brand identity(Watermark/Logo), apply your watermark on your videos and get your desired attention from others by sharing your eye catching watermarked videos on social media. 

Video Watermark is a fast and easy to use app to create and apply watermark on video. Create your own watermark or use existing watermark template and apply on any of your video on the go.

Video Watermark comes with professional Watermark/ Logo Maker so that you can create your own brand identity(Logo) and Advance video editing tool helps you to apply watermark on video easily. 

Video Watermark adds watermark to your video to make it personalize. Also you can set watermark position, color and opacity over your video to personalize or copyright video.


WHY USE VIDEO WATERMARK:

✔ Fast and easy to use with user friendly UI.
✔ High Quality video generated.
✔ Easy to create watermark with "Create Watermark" feature.
✔ Easy to Modify Watermark or Add On Video.
✔ Supports MP4 and major format in Videos
✔ Easy to adjust position, size, hue.
✔ Change transparency of your added watermark.
✔ Easy to save.
✔ View all generated video in album gallery.
✔ Delete or Easy sharing to Social Media.


FEATURE:

● Select a Video from gallery to be edit.
● Create or Choose a Watermark.
● Adjust size, position hue and transparency of Watermark.
● Then Apply and wait for process to complete or choose notify me later.
● "Notify me later" feature notify you when your video with Watermark is ready.
● Notification Feature show you notification with process(i.e. how much is done) even if your app is not opened.
● Save your time because you need not to wait for the process to complete if once started.
● Preview your saved video and share easily.
